<subject>GRIDMASTER/LOAD CONTROL AVAILABILITY</subject>
<body>
To all GRIDMASTER users:

The GRIDMASTER platform will be offline nightly from 00:01 to 04:00 CET for system maintenance. It will be back online each morning, with grid forecasts updated and ready by 05:30.

LOAD CONTROL functions will remain accessible during this period.

If you have any questions, please contact the GRIDMASTER Support Team at +49 171 373 5700.
</body>
